Robber.name: Bandyta
Robber.description: Uliczny bandyta uzbrojony w sztylet. Szybki i podstępny.

Skeleton.name: Szkielet
Skeleton.description: Zmarły człowiek wskrzeszony za pomocą czarnej magii. Jego kości klikają w walce.

Monster.name: Potwór
Monster.description: Straszne stworzenie z bagien, z pazurami i ostrymi zębami.

Witch.name: Czarownica
Witch.description: Mroczna czarodziejka, władająca magicznymi atakami i klątwami.

Drunkard.name: Pijak
Drunkard.description: Miejscowy awanturnik z tawerny. Często nie rozumie, z kim walczy.

Werewolf.name: Wampir
Werewolf.description: Człowiek-bestia, niesamowicie szybki i niebezpieczny w walce wręcz.

DarkKnight.name: Mroczny Rycerz
DarkKnight.description: Potężny wojownik w czarnej zbroi, służący ciemnym siłom.

Blacksmith.name: Gregor the Blacksmith
Blacksmith.description: A sturdy man with soot-covered hands. He can upgrade your weapons and armor for a fair price.
dialogue: I can strengthen that armor of yours for the right coin.
Steel is only as strong as the hand that wields it.

Healer.name: Mira the Healer
Healer.description: A kind woman who knows the secrets of herbs and healing. She can heal wounds and sell potions.
dialogue: Your wounds look deep — let me tend to them.
I have potions that might help you on your journey.
Even the strongest warriors fall — let me help you stand again.

Merchant.name: Tomas the Merchant
Merchant.description: A shrewd trader with goods from distant lands. You can buy or sell items here.
dialogue: Take a look — finest goods you'll find anywhere.
Looking to sell something? Let me see what you've got.
Gold speaks louder than words, my friend.

Traveler.name: Eldrin the Wanderer
Traveler.description: A mysterious traveler who shares stories, rumors, or offers side quests.
dialogue: I've walked many roads — perhaps I can share some wisdom.
There are whispers of hidden treasures nearby.
A brave soul like you might be interested in a task I know of.
